run_hermes_worker: run the Hermes agent worker that connects to the GAIA2 adapter via Unix socket and processes conversation requests
create_hermes_agent: create a Hermes AIAgent instance with provider config, system prompt, and tool-call ID normalization patches
patch_hermes_tool_call_ids: patch the Hermes AIAgent class to normalize tool-call IDs and prevent orphaned tool outputs from provider quirks
install_trace_logging: install trace logging on the Hermes agent to record LLM API call requests, responses, latency, and HTTP status to a trace file
connect_to_adapter: connect to the GAIA2 adapter Unix socket with configurable retry interval and timeout for the Hermes worker
